cards.title: Attention Validation
cards.interpretation: Historically, this archetype captures moments when elevated attention and positive tone appeared together.
cards.public_takeaway: Attention Validation currently shows constructive historical evidence: 682 events across 47 terms, with a 7d mean edge of 0.42% and a 7d win rate of 62.77% versus 57.22% baseline.
caveats: Historical diagnostic only; not a trade signal, recommendation, or price forecast.
